summary: Duplicate recommendations are merged into one finding, and each task sent to ServiceNow carries its full context.

new.title: Full task context to ServiceNow and SQL
new.text: Each remediation task carries what to do first, paths, the recommended update, CVE ids, risk, due date, the asset and a link to its page. Add the new columns from the connector page's table definition.

new.title: Duplicates not merged are shown
new.text: Operations > Data quality shows duplicates not merged, and the run log warns with examples.

fixes.title: Duplicate recommendations are merged
fixes.text: An 'Update <software>' recommendation for software whose CVEs are already on the asset becomes evidence on those CVE findings ('Also reported by').

fixes.title: A merged recommendation closes as 'Linked'
fixes.text: It is sent to ServiceNow and the SQL hand-off as closed 'Linked' to the CVE finding, never as fixed and never dropped.

fixes.title: The job buttons work again
fixes.text: Run now, Stop, schedule changes, template release and mail send-now go to the installation through a queue.

fixes.title: Support access answers each request in turn
fixes.text: A support session's close no longer cancels another session's waiting request.

fixes.title: Guests are recognised again at sign-in
fixes.text: Guests kept by e-mail address are looked up once and stored, with no object id to enter by hand.
